# PaperTrail — agent research database, API v2

Read-only venue metadata, researcher candidates and citation relationships.
GitHub Pages serves static resources; local SDK/MCP code runs queries. No key.

- [Agent webpage](https://jimmywuhkust.github.io/papertrail/agents/): working identity, paper and citation explorer; copyable calls and capability matrix.
- [Complete plain-text guide](https://jimmywuhkust.github.io/papertrail/agents/README.md): startup, exact semantics, result shapes, parameters, evidence, recipes and migration.
- [Manifest](https://jimmywuhkust.github.io/papertrail/api/v2/manifest.json): snapshot, coverage, versions, capabilities, sizes and SHA-256 checksums.
- [Python SDK / local MCP](https://jimmywuhkust.github.io/papertrail/agents/papertrail.py): dependency-free, lazy verified SQLite; eleven tools.
- [JavaScript SDK](https://jimmywuhkust.github.io/papertrail/agents/papertrail.mjs): Node 22+ / browser; compressed resources on demand.
- [Tool contracts](https://jimmywuhkust.github.io/papertrail/api/v2/tools.json): callable local queries, complete input/output schemas.
- [Response/error schemas](https://jimmywuhkust.github.io/papertrail/api/v2/schemas.json): schemaVersion 2 envelopes, identities, papers, citation evidence and structured errors.
- [Static OpenAPI](https://jimmywuhkust.github.io/papertrail/api/v2/openapi.json): actual HTTPS file endpoints; no hosted query-string search.

First task: authors("Mo Li", affiliation="HKUST"), inspect candidates, then
author_papers / authorPapers using the chosen stable author ID.
Identity evidence is distinct from publication-time affiliation.
Name-only groups are explicitly unresolved; equal names do not establish identity.

Search defaults to title/topics, all_tokens; explicitly request authors for names.
Names match within one author entry; both SDKs share tokens, scores and ordering.
Results use items, coverage, warnings and snapshot/query-bound pagination cursors.
Resolve states: resolved, external_reference, not_in_snapshot; malformed input errors.
Distinguish upstreamCitationCount, incomingCorpusCitationCount, recordedReferenceCount.
Empty unknown references do not prove zero references. Preserve source evidence.

Coverage: 86,426 records, 10 venues, 2016–2025; corpus incoming citations only.
No abstracts/full text. Related work is inferred metadata/neighbor similarity.
Python/MCP add coupling/co-citation/bounded graphs; JavaScript declares these
unsupported. status checks readiness; warm_cache prepares SQLite explicitly.
Pin snapshot resources and archive SDK/data for reproducibility; Pages retains
the current snapshot only. Cached historical snapshots are not silently mixed.
